Evidence: Punjab mein BJP ke leaders ko public mein maar peet ka samna karna pad raha hai, aur unki jaan ko khatra hai (Source 1). BJP workers demoralized hain aur unhe social boycott ka samna karna pad raha hai (Source 1). Anil Joshi ne kaha ki koi bhi BJP ka jhanda nahi utha sakta Punjab mein (Source 1). Iske alawa, BJP ke leaders ko farmers ke protests ke liye kuch nahi kehne diya gaya hai (Source 1). Punjab ki situation kharab hai aur log BJP ke khilaf protest kar rahe hain (Source 1).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Punjab mein BJP ki situation bohot kharab hai. Anil Joshi ne kaha hai ki koi bhi BJP ka jhanda nahi utha sakta, aur BJP workers ko public mein maar peet ka samna karna pad raha hai. Yeh sab kuch is claim ko support karta hai ki Punjab mein situation kharab ho rahi hai aur log BJP ko chhod rahe hain. Isliye, yeh claim sahi hai.
